_comment: Rust files that still carry an inline #[cfg(test)] mod name { ... } body, as of the day scripts/no-inline-tests.mjs went in (2026-09-23). A file on this list may lose its inline module, and then has to come off the list; a file not on the list may not grow one. So the list only shrinks, the same shape as scripts/file-sizes.json. A file moves its test module out by giving it its own file under crates/*/tests/unit/ and leaving a #[cfg(test)] #[path = "..."] mod name; hook behind (no body), the shape crates/api/src/gates/mod.rs already uses (mod tests; naming a sibling tests.rs, which needs no #[path] since the file sits next to it).
